$comment: Tracked on purpose. Only .claude/skills/ is gitignored, this file is not.
On every session start, link the real skills from 00_system/skills/ (visible in
Obsidian) into .claude/skills/ (where Claude Code looks). Both commands are listed;
the one for the other platform fails harmlessly and does not stop the session.
Git never carries a symlink, so the Windows 42-byte-stub problem cannot return.
First session after a clone still starts without the skills — they are read at
startup and the hook is a moment too late. The script says so when that happens.
